title: 2005 AMC 12A Problem 22
statement: A rectangular box \(P\) is inscribed in a sphere of radius \(r.\) The surface area of \(P\) is \(384,\) and the sum of the lengths of its \(12\) edges is \(112.\) What is \(r?\)

solutions.text:
Let the dimensions be \(x, y, z.\) The \(12\) edges give \(4(x + y + z) = 112,\) so \(x + y + z = 28,\) and the surface area gives \(2xy + 2yz + 2xz = 384.\)

The space diagonal is a diameter of the sphere, so \[ \begin{aligned} &(2r)^2 = x^2 + y^2 + z^2 \\ &= (x + y + z)^2 \\ &\quad {}- (2xy + 2yz + 2xz) \\ &= 28^2 - 384 = 400. \end{aligned} \]

Thus \(2r = 20\) and \(r = 10.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
